neighbours.label: The fragment '-m' (or a split-off 'm') that starts a word part after a hyphenated or fused prefix: cond-m|at, β-D-m|altoside, D-m|annoside, in|m|igración
fire: Her first paper appeared on the arXiv as cond-mat/9807112 in the summer.
The membrane protein was solubilized with n-decyl-β-D-maltoside overnight.
The lectin binds strongly to methyl-α-D-mannoside in solution.
The article is listed under cond-mat/0412310 and has been cited widely.
Miles de familias esperan una respuesta de la oficina de inmigración.
Crystals grew only when n-undecyl-β-D-maltoside was added to the buffer.
A revised version, cond-mat/0209455, corrected the error in the third figure.
El abogado de inmigración revisó todos los papeles de la familia.
quiet: Her first paper appeared on the arXiv as hep-th/9807112 in the summer.
The membrane protein was solubilized with n-octyl-β-D-glucoside overnight.
The lectin binds strongly to methyl-α-D-galactoside in solution.
The article is listed under astro-ph/0412310 and has been cited widely.
Miles de familias esperan una respuesta de la oficina de correos.
Crystals grew only when n-nonyl-β-D-glucoside was added to the buffer.
A revised version, quant-ph/0209455, corrected the error in the third figure.
El abogado de la emigración revisó todos los papeles de la familia.

notes: Top tokens: 'm' x4, '-m' x3, ' M' x3, ' imm' x2. The - pole's output promotes 'at', 'ation', 'ati'. Probe: cond-mat 0.56, D-maltoside 0.63, D-mannoside 0.55, inmigración 0.60; hep-th 0.00, D-glucoside 0.02, emigración 0.08. The + pole also fires on m-fragments (' m', '-m', '_rem'), so the two poles split the same family by what follows.
